mapper.select: SELECT id FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{adjustmentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM supplier_adjustment_dispute_resolution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND adjustment_id=#{id} ORDER BY resolved_version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_payable_adjustment_operation SET state_json=#{stateJson},version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},dispatches=#{dispatches},highest_revision=#{highestRevision},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND command_json=#{commandJson} AND command_digest=#{digest} AND retired_version IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_payment_id=#{paymentId}
SELECT * FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{paymentId} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT * FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{paymentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{paymentId} AND (created_at<#{createdAt} OR (created_at=#{expectedCreatedAt} AND id<#{id})) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT state_json FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_payable_adjustment_operation SET active_payment_id=NULL,retired_version=#{operationVersion} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{operationId} AND version=#{version} AND active_payment_id=payment_id AND retired_version IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier_adjustment_retirement WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{id}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_operation q LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_authorization origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.payment_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=origin.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE q.retired_version IS NULL AND ((q.status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status IN ('CHECKING','ADJUSTING','QUERYING') AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil})) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_operation q LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_authorization origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.payment_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=origin.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE q.status='ADJUSTED' AND q.retired_version IS NULL AND q.completed_version IS NULL ORDER BY q.updated_at,q.id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_payable_adjustment_operation SET completed_version=#{version},active_payment_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND state_json=#{stateJson} AND status='ADJUSTED' AND retired_version IS NULL AND completed_version IS NULL AND active_payment_id=payment_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM supplier_adjustment_completion c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{expectedTenantId} AND c.operation_id=#{operationId} AND c.operation_version=#{operationVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id,accounted_entry_count FROM supplier_adjustment_completion WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{id} AND operation_version=#{completedVersion}
SELECT version,state_json FROM supplier_payable_adjustment_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{parameters[0]} AND operation_id=#{parameters[1]} AND version<=#{parameters[2]} ORDER BY version
